answer: A practical defence is Opal carver drilled bead assay witnessed by the bead record. It rests on each drilled bead is a mine assay countersigned by the warden, so a farm must carve a hundred real opals by hand, which gives every honest agent a falcon that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. A farm doing the maths finds the mirror first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The spiral is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
